get.description: readonlyMode also reflects whether the caller lacks config.write.

403.description: The caller lacks the permission, or the origin or CSRF check failed

post.summary: Activate the setup config and leave setup mode
post.description: Writes the candidate config and records a pending activation for the `vllm-sr serve` that owns the stack; the Dashboard does not start containers. Error bodies are JSON or plain text; choose the parser by Content-Type.

200.description: Config saved and activation recorded. message says whether an attached `vllm-sr serve` is starting the stack or the user must run `vllm-sr serve`; Envoy starts only in stacks that run it

202.description: Config saved to the Kubernetes ConfigMap; a rollout applies it

400.description: The setup config is unavailable or the candidate is invalid

403.description: JSON when the Dashboard is read-only (error readonly_mode); text when the caller lacks the permission, the origin or CSRF check failed, the session was revoked, or the ConfigMap is controller-owned

409.description: JSON when another config change holds the lock (error deploy_in_progress or managed_recipe_active); text when setup is no longer active or the ConfigMap changed or awaits a rollout

500.description: JSON error setup_activation_failed after the config was written: stage names the failed step and configuration_restored says whether a retry is safe. JSON error config_coordination_failed when the config lock is unavailable. Text when the config could not be read, converted, backed up, or persisted

post.summary: Import a setup config from a remote URL

400.description: The setup config is unavailable, the body is invalid, or the destination is not permitted

403.description: The caller lacks the permission, or the origin or CSRF check failed

413.description: The remote config exceeds the size limit

502.description: The remote config could not be fetched

403.description: The caller lacks the permission, or the origin or CSRF check failed

post.summary: Compare configured models with a preset

403.description: The caller lacks the permission, or the origin or CSRF check failed
